# Release fetches retry on a fixed 2s schedule through two stacked retry layers, so one upstream blip…

## Summary

**Failure mode** — Release fetches retry on a fixed 2s schedule through two stacked retry layers, so one upstream blip becomes 20 requests per caller arriving in lockstep

**Prediction** — The next incident on this path is a retry storm after a brief upstream degradation, not a slow dependency

## Trigger

**Trigger** — The releases API returns 5xx or times out for more than two seconds while several callers are active

**Preconditions** — none: the failure happens on default settings.

## Mechanism

**Amplifier** — The loop retries 5 times and the mesh route retries each 5xx up to 3 more times; attempts multiply to 5 x 4 = 20 rather than adding. withRetry adds 3 attempts only when fetch throws, so a 5xx passes straight through it

## Persistence

**Sustaining effect** — Every client waits exactly SLEEP\_MS and returns together, so the upstream is re-saturated the moment it starts recovering — the herd re-forms on its own schedule

## Fix options

**Proposal, not verified** — drafted by a model from this finding. Nothing checked it.

- Keep one retry layer: drop the loop in fetchRelease and let withRetry own the attempts, so a 5xx is tried 4 times in all, not 20.
- Or keep the loop and set the mesh route to one attempt for this service; the multiplication is gone either way.
- Add jitter to whichever layer stays, so clients stop returning together.

How to fix: [`fix-agent-instructions.md`](https://github.com/tomstagl/thunderstruck/blob/main/docs/fix-agent-instructions.md) · how to review: [`review-briefs.md`](https://github.com/tomstagl/thunderstruck/blob/main/docs/review-briefs.md)

## Acceptance criteria

**Proposal, not verified** — drafted by a model from this finding. Nothing checked it.

- With the releases endpoint answering 503 for 15 seconds, ten clients send at most 4 requests each.
- The gaps between one client's attempts are not all equal.
- A single transient 5xx still reaches no caller.

How to fix: [`fix-agent-instructions.md`](https://github.com/tomstagl/thunderstruck/blob/main/docs/fix-agent-instructions.md) · how to review: [`review-briefs.md`](https://github.com/tomstagl/thunderstruck/blob/main/docs/review-briefs.md)
